text.tspan: Also remember: never smoke around Class 1 (explosives), Class 3 (flammable), or Division 2.1 (flammable gas). Do not load Division
1.1/1.2, Class 3, or Division 2.1 in a cargo space with a heater/air-conditioner unit unless you have read all the related rules.
